$comment: Fixed-name folders directly under /tmp that shipped files may mention. /tmp is world-writable and shared, so any local account can create a fixed-name folder first and have a root process work through it. tests/test_tmp_path_policy.py scans every tracked text file outside tests/ and .claude/ and fails on a /tmp/<name> that is not listed here as the exact (file, tmp_path) pair, and on an entry here that matches nothing. Prefer PrivateTmp=yes, RuntimeDirectory=/StateDirectory=, mktemp -d (or $RUNNER_TEMP in workflows) or a root-owned /run/<name> over adding an entry. Each `why` must say why the use is safe.
